comparison_rule: Compare parsed JSON recursively after removing only wall_seconds, cpu_seconds and peak_rss_kib; compare every .model/.inquiry checkpoint as exact bytes. HTML branding and layout are not scientific outcomes.

initial_failure.context: Independent pre-measurement gated-delay +/-1 fixture. Each single edit could fail to improve before composition.
initial_failure.resolution: All v3 controls receive one composed-topology lookahead using the existing proposer with remaining budget. No failed intermediate is accepted. This change was recorded in the v3 protocol before final measurement; v2 was preserved.

efficiency_review: No network/storage calls inside candidate scoring or query selection. Bank <=16, replay <=256 examples, witnesses <=32 per skill, six topology shapes, 11790 graph hypotheses/source, 32 query cap. Files are written once per completed stream/condition. Active query selection explicitly costs more CPU work than random querying.
scope: Retention, window-level automatic routing, parameterized learned graph abstractions and active observations now have implementations, persistence, controls, inspection and measurements. These close the bounded prototype gates, not an open-ended intelligence research claim.
limits: Routing needs observed outcomes from a fixed-size window; it cannot anticipate an unobservable change.
Active old graph forgetting remains; the bounded bank holds retained skills.
No arbitrary new primitives or learned curiosity objective; grammar and query criterion are designed.
Empty version space also signals missing grammar or corrupt evidence, not only noise.
Query selection has substantially higher compute cost despite better interaction efficiency.
Only three seeds and known small synthetic task families; no frontier or general-assistant claim.
State restoration is verified; whole-campaign interruption recovery is not implemented.
Operation proxies and tiny shared-host timings are not a matched latency benchmark.
